posts.author: EvilJef
posts.body: I wasn't sure which category was appropriate to post this to, but I just joined, so I thought I would introduce myself a little.  I've always wanted to make my own RPG, and a few months ago, I finally downloaded RPG Maker MV on the Switch.  I'm still, slowly learning how to use it, piece by piece, but I'm finding out that there are things I wanted to do that require plugins, which I can't use on the Switch, so I'm thinking of joining Steam to get it on there.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: Welcome to the forum. This place is more for the PC makers too. If you don't like steam, they have the Komodo Plaza here, where you can also buy the makers straight from the guys who made it basically!

posts.author: EvilJef
posts.body: Thank you.  I'm not actually on Steam yet.  I was just going to join for this, but I wasn't sure if it would be better to go with Steam or just buy it straight from the source.  I only bought it on the Switch because it went on sale for $15, and I couldn't pass it up, and I didn't realize the limitations of that version beforehand.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Yeah that how they get people. The benefit of using steam is that you'll always have access to it. (Well, unless steam goes down I guess). If you buy it from Komodo, you'll get a download link, and if you lose that link somehow, you're kinda screwed.
All the PC makers goes on big sales regularly too, or you can use key seller sites for a bargain as well.

posts.author: EvilJef
posts.body:
I just looked at the option to buy it from here, and if I'm seeing this correctly, it looks like it is originally $79, and it's currently on sale for $12.  I would have been very hesitant to spend $79 on it, since I was expecting $50, the original price on the Switch.  If it's really only $12 right now, that less than what I already bought it for!
Steam might have been more portable for me, so I could use it during my lunch at work, but I'm feeling like I'd get the most out of just buying it from here instead.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: Nothing wrong with that! Whatever works for you. I prefer how steam handles things. They go on sale for 12 bucks there too, though, not currently. Either way works! Once again welcome to the forum, and have fun with all the new possibilities that the PC maker brings to you!

posts.author: EvilJef
posts.body: Thank you very much.  I'm sure I'm going to be on here with a lot of questions to help build my game.

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome to the forum!
Just as an aside, I have a Steam Deck where you can technically run MV from Desk Top mode like a regular computer and has all the functionality and plugins (because the Steam Deck is a computer).
HOWEVER, programming on a handheld is a nightmare. Especially trying to do anything related to dialog. I imagine the Switch would have similar challenges in that regard, but maybe not.
I hope everything works out for you.
Good luck on your projects and remember to enjoy what you do!

posts.author: EvilJef
posts.body: I've officially purchased it, and I'm awaiting the download on my very slow internet!
